items.name: Crocs Trailbreak 2 Tech SE Cordura - Black
items.description: The Special Edition of the shoe built for beyond boundaries. The Trailbreak 2 Tech SE features the same unique design, but with a range of premium materials, including Cordura® panels around the upper for increased durability. The bootie-style collar is framed by stretch lycra, and the patterned mesh upper is wrapped in a leather overlay to add breathability and dimension. The simplified lacing system is easily adjustable and packable over a metallic-textile tongue. Underfoot, a rugged rubber outsole delivers traction and durability, grounded by a LiteRide™ footbed for all-day, all-terrain comfort. Crocs Trailbreak 2 Tech SE Cordura Details: Cordura® durable ripstop fabric upper Special Edition of Trailbreak 2 Tech Bootie-style collar for easy slip on EVA toecap for added protection Sink-in LiteRide™ cushioned footbed Simplified lacing system

items.name: Crocs Trailbreak 2 Tech SE Cordura - Black
items.description: The Special Edition of the shoe built for beyond boundaries. The Trailbreak 2 Tech SE features the same unique design, but with a range of premium materials, including Cordura® panels around the upper for increased durability. The bootie-style collar is framed by stretch lycra, and the patterned mesh upper is wrapped in a leather overlay to add breathability and dimension. The simplified lacing system is easily adjustable and packable over a metallic-textile tongue. Underfoot, a rugged rubber outsole delivers traction and durability, grounded by a LiteRide™ footbed for all-day, all-terrain comfort. Crocs Trailbreak 2 Tech SE Cordura Details: Cordura® durable ripstop fabric upper Special Edition of Trailbreak 2 Tech Bootie-style collar for easy slip on EVA toecap for added protection Sink-in LiteRide™ cushioned footbed Simplified lacing system

items.name: Pendleton Classic Lined Clog - Multi
items.description: Slip into something comfortable with the Pendleton Classic Lined Clog. This limited-edition style celebrates over a century of iconic American artistry with the vibrant Nehalem pattern that celebrates the meeting of land and water. This heritage pattern was inspired by the earthy spectrum of colors of the Pacific Northwest, from the rugged shoreline to the ancient forests of Oregon. The clog’s upper is adorned with bespoke charms strung along a unique paracord cuff, in addition to two exclusive Jibbitz™ charms. The interior of the clog features a plush lining and cushioned footbed for comfort that keeps up with any adventure. Pendleton Classic Lined Clog Details: The legendary Classic Clog, now with a warm, fuzzy liner Covered in Pendleton Nehalem pattern Features carabiner cord with charms fixed to rivets across upper Includes 2 exclusive Jibbitz™ charms including a fish and camping cup Incredibly light and easy to wear Pivoting heel straps for a more secure fit Great indoors or out Customizable with Jibbitz™ charms Dual Crocs Comfort™: Blissfully supportive. Soft. Cradling comfort.

Athletic stripes around the sole nod to vintage team gear, while oversized Jibbitz™ charms give the upper that bold varsity-patch look. Featuring menacing Bulldogs and elevated flair, this pair is all about showing off your University of Georgia pride. Consider these your new uniform for game days and beyond. Flexible. 360-degree comfort.

items.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Blue-Eyes White Dragon Echo Clog - Multi
items.description: The Yu-Gi-Oh! Blue-Eyes White Dragon Echo Clog is a fearsome style inspired by extraordinary power. Covered in an ice blue colorway, the cutting-edge Echo silhouette mimics the aesthetic of biomechanical armor. Dimensional details wrap the upper, like the Blue-Eyes White Dragon’s jaw, and 4 elevated enamel Jibbitz™ charms. This fearsome style is what legends are made of. Yu-Gi-Oh! Blue-Eyes White Dragon Echo Clog Details: Incredibly light and easy to wear Ice blue colorway Dimensional PVC spiked detail on each shoe Includes 4 enamel Jibbitz™ charms Hieroglyph print and heel pad on back strap Fully molded Croslite upper and foundation Water-friendly and buoyant; weighs only ounces Ventilation ports add breathability and help shed water Easy to clean and quick to dry Customizable with Jibbitz™ charms Dual density support with Croslite sole and LiteRide™ Footbed Exclusive Gift With Purchase: Purchase any participating Yu-Gi-Oh! footwear style and receive an exclusive trading card, while supplies last.
